hook.name: Volatility Adaptive USDCWETH Hook V8
hook.description: A single WETH/USDC pool hook on Base that dynamically adjusts LP fees (0.01%–99.99%) using signed off-chain multi-venue market reports cross-checked against Chainlink and Pyth price anchors. Fees fall back to 3% when market data is stale. Strategy fees are split 90% to LPs and 10% to an immutable Safe address, with an owner-controlled emergency pause mechanism.
